summary: Backend-only test run for LatinHub MVP. Wrote pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/ covering all 19 requested features (auth, events, djs, mixes, cities) plus extra edge cases. 22/22 tests pass against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Admin seed, JWT bearer auth, seeded content, filtering, and play-count increment all verified. No backend bugs found.
action_items: Informational only: seeded events count is actually 9 (not 8 as stated in review request) - all 9 distinct entries in _make_events() were inserted. Test asserts >=8 and passes; main agent may want to update the review statement.
CORS is configured with allow_origins=['*'] and allow_credentials=False. This is fine for a Bearer-token mobile app but would need tightening if httpOnly cookies are ever reintroduced.
MOCKED content reminder (already disclosed in review request): mix audio_urls use SoundHelix placeholders and spotify_playlist_urls use generic Spotify embeds, not real Mauro Catalini playlists.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~636 lines) is borderline; fine for MVP but consider splitting auth/events/djs/mixes into modules as the app grows.
get_mix() both returns the mix and increments plays on every GET - this means opening a mix detail screen will inflate play counts. Acceptable for an MVP but worth flagging.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') instead of FastAPI lifespan context manager. Works but emits DeprecationWarnings on newer FastAPI.
seed_admin correctly handles password rotation (bcrypt re-hash on mismatch). Verified bcrypt hashes start with $2b$.
_id is excluded via projection on every Mongo read - good.
seed_data_creation: No manual seed created. Relied on server startup auto-seed (admin user, 6 DJs, 9 events, 5 mixes). Test-created resources are prefixed TEST_ and use unique UUID emails so reruns stay idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public base URL comes from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (NOT EXPO_BACKEND_URL). conftest.py handles both. Admin creds: admin@latinhub.it / admin123. Backend uses Bearer JWT (7-day expiry), no cookies. Event register/login lowercases email server-side - assert against email.lower(). GET /api/mixes/{id} increments plays on every call. Seeded counts: 6 DJs, 9 events, 5 mixes.
